name: Cachapoal Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

notes: Bright sun, Andes breezes and cool nights give Cabernet Sauvignon consistent ripeness.

blurb.text: A zone of the Rapel Valley subregion, in Chile's Central Valley region.
